contention_note: Wall seconds were measured with 2 census workers while other sessions ran ~4 CPU-bound processes on the same 8-core machine; child_cpu_s is the contention-robust column (slowest board: 116.65 s wall vs 55.83 s CPU).

finding.why: No board in the corpus reached the 300 s budget on this machine (the slowest is under half of it), so there is no slow class for a predicate to separate; and the signature ranks fill time so weakly that boards whose every signature component lies within 2x of the slowest board's fill in a small fraction of its time. The cost driver is the count of copper items the fill must clear (segments + vias), which _fill_cost_key does not carry. No threshold is implemented; the fallback is DISCLOSED instead (JSON_SUMMARY.plane_fragility.machine_dependent).

what: kicad_exact_fill.refill_islands_ex timed per board (wall seconds of the pcbnew subprocess + island parse; child CPU seconds), next to kicad_oracle._fill_cost_key and extra board features. Produced by tests/stress/fill_timing_census.py.
